name: aggregate-reporting
summary: Reporting agents aggregate allow-listed PostgreSQL tables and never read rows: aggregates use public and internal columns only, return at most 100 groups, and small groups are suppressed by the connection.
protects: no agent reads rows through pc.postgres: row reads are refused org-wide, for every agent
aggregates use only public and internal columns: values of pii and secret columns never reach the agent
an aggregate returns at most 100 groups
groups smaller than the connection's minimum group size are suppressed by the gateway, and no aggregate returns row values (HR-312)
the agent's grant covers aggregates and reading the table list only
excludes: what the tables hold: only the tables and columns in the connection's manifest can be read at all; review its classes
inference across many aggregates (differencing): limit the agent's budget or count of queries
data scoping rules need the Team edition
the limits are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them
grant: aggregates over the connection's tables and reading the table list

connections: a pc.postgres connection in enforce mode with a manifest that classes every column
